title: nonReentrant is not the first modifier on claim() (whenNotPaused executes before the reentrancy guard engages)
plausibility: n/a (no exploit path; likely contextual false-positive)
description: claim() declares `whenNotPaused nonReentrant` (L447), so whenNotPaused executes before the reentrancy guard engages. whenNotPaused is a pure storage read of the `paused` flag with no external call and no state change, so the ordering is harmless in context. A defensive note (put nonReentrant first) from a single static source (aderyn).
